text: 后来，魏国的国君换成了武侯。魏国任命宰相，用了田文。吴起很不高兴，去找田文比功劳。他一连比了三件事，其中两件是：统领三军，让士兵乐意为国拼命，敌国不敢打魏国的主意，你比我怎样？田文说：「不如子」，不如你。镇守西河，让秦兵不敢向东进犯，韩、赵两国都来归附，你比我怎样？田文还是说不如你。三件比完，吴起问：这三件你都在我之下，职位却在我之上，这是为什么？

Later, with Marquis Wu now ruling Wei, the state appointed a chief minister and chose Tian Wen. Wu Qi was displeased and challenged Tian Wen to compare their merits. He compared them on three counts; two of them were these. In command of the armies, making soldiers glad to die and enemy states afraid to plot against Wei, how do you compare with me? Tian Wen said: Not as well as you. Holding Xihe, so that Qin's troops dare not march east and Han and Zhao come as guests, how do you compare with me? Again Tian Wen said he could not match him. When the three were done, Wu Qi asked: in all three you rank below me, yet your post ranks above mine. Why?

仆人的计策是：第一步，公叔先去对武侯说：吴起是个贤人，可是您的国家小，又和强大的秦国接壤，我私下担心吴起没有长久留下的心。照仆人的设计，武侯会问：那怎么办？公叔就建议「試延以公主」，拿把公主许配给吴起来试探他：有心留下，一定会接受；无心留下，一定会推辞，「以此卜之」，就用这件事来占卜他的去留。第二步，公叔再请吴起到家里，让自己娶的那位公主当着吴起的面发怒、轻慢公叔。仆人断定，吴起看到公主这样轻贱自己的丈夫，一定会推辞这门婚事。

The servant's plan: in step one, Gongshu would tell Marquis Wu that Wu Qi was a man of worth, but that the marquis's state was small and bordered on mighty Qin, and he privately feared Wu Qi had no mind to stay. In the servant's script, the marquis would ask what to do. Gongshu would then propose testing Wu Qi with the offer of a princess: if he meant to stay he would surely accept, and if not he would surely decline, so the offer would serve as a divination of his intentions. In step two, Gongshu would then invite Wu Qi home and have the princess he had married flare up and slight him in front of Wu Qi. Seeing a princess treat her husband with such contempt, the servant predicted, Wu Qi would surely turn the marriage down.
